_comment: ASSUMED schema. The real Quantro export format is unknown. Placeholder data only. The mapping from these field names to WebScan's Finding fields lives in config/providers.json under quantro.field_mapping.

findings.title: WordPress plugin File Manager: unauthenticated file upload
findings.description: The installed File Manager plugin version allows anyone on the internet to upload and run files on the web server without logging in.
findings.solution: Update the File Manager plugin to the latest version or remove it.

findings.title: jQuery 1.12.4: cross-site scripting in HTML manipulation methods
findings.description: The page loads an old jQuery version that can run attacker-supplied script when untrusted HTML is inserted into the page.

findings.title: jQuery 1.12.4: cross-site scripting via htmlPrefilter
findings.description: Old jQuery versions mishandle HTML from untrusted sources.

findings.title: jQuery 1.12.4: prototype pollution in jQuery.extend
findings.description: Old jQuery versions allow modification of built-in object behavior.

findings.title: SQL injection in donation search form
findings.description: The search box passes what a visitor types directly into a database query, so a visitor could read donor records from the database.
findings.solution: Use parameterized queries for all database access.

findings.title: Reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) in campaign page
findings.description: The campaign page repeats part of the web address back to the visitor without cleaning it.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header
findings.description: The site does not tell browsers to always use a secure connection.

findings.title: Administrator login does not require multi-factor authentication
findings.description: Administrator accounts can sign in with only a password.
findings.solution: Require a second factor for all administrator accounts.

findings.title: jQuery 1.12.4: cross-site scripting in HTML manipulation methods
findings.description: The page loads an old jQuery version that can run attacker-supplied script when untrusted HTML is inserted into the page.

findings.title: Default administrator credentials accepted on staging CMS
findings.description: The staging content management system still accepts the vendor's default administrator username and password.
findings.solution: Change the default password and restrict access to the staging site.

findings.title: SMBv1 enabled: remote code execution (EternalBlue, MS17-010)
findings.description: The file server still accepts the outdated SMBv1 file sharing protocol and is missing the MS17-010 security update.
findings.solution: Install the MS17-010 update and disable SMBv1.

findings.title: Operating system is end of life and no longer supported
findings.description: The file server runs an operating system version that no longer receives security updates from the vendor.
findings.solution: Migrate to a supported operating system version.

findings.title: Directory listing enabled
findings.description: The web server shows a list of every file in the uploads folder.

findings.title: Incomplete example record (no host) that ingestion must skip

findings: this entry is not an object and must be skipped without stopping ingestion
